«قَالَ: وَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ» is a first-person narrative whose speaker is not named in the text (rule 11). The Imam Abu Ja'far is written as the single link (rule 5); the asker is not written. Bare kunya not identified (owner ruling 3).
«قال: و سألت أبا جعفر» has a first-person speaker who is not named, and no previous report is in the context (rule 11).
The Imam asked and answering is the last link, written as the text names him (owner ruling 2).
